Definition: from G5228 and G4121; to superabound:--be exceeding abundant.
BiblicalUsage: hyperpleonázō means to abound exceedingly. In 1 Timothy 1:14, the text says "And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, hyperpleonázō, does its job quietly — to abound exceedingly — and I leave it at that.
